request: Update Jarvis from the settings page
observed: The updater rejected the placeholder repository in release metadata before downloading the installer.
expected: Metadata names the actual release repository; its URL passes the installed updater's repository allowlist, its digest matches the installer, and installation can start.
regressions: The build-time repository drives both metadata fetching and installer validation.
Missing build configuration disables updates instead of using a placeholder.
Other repositories, traversal, query strings and fragments remain rejected.
Generated metadata uses the same build-time repository and the actual installer SHA256.

verification.software: Rust and Python regression fixtures pass; Windows GNU type checks pass. Native installation remains unobserved.
verification.note: Linux fixtures and CI packaging do not prove installation on the user's Windows PC.
